tei:div.tei:p: sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// thub pa'i dbang po rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa rdo rje gdan pa dang*// ba ri lo tsā grub chen glen ga bar// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// bshes gnyen sgre pa mnyam med sgam po pa// sgom tshul shes rab byang chub 'dul 'dzin zhabs// 'bri gung gling pa dam chos gling pa la// gsol ba 'debs= /chos kyi tshul khrims mnyam med lha lung pa// thog gnas pa dang chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs// skye dgu'i 'dren mchog byang chub bzang po la// gsol ba= /thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs// bsod nams lha dbang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan dang*// mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun phrin las par// gsol ba= /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rje btsun bcom ldan ma// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku yi snang brnyan ni// blo mtshor shar ba'i mod nas 'chi bdag bdud// ming gi mthar byas 'chi med 'grub par shog /snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lor yig 'brur bcas// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar babs pa yis// lus kun phyur bur gtams pa'i dga' ston gyis// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub 'grub par shog /'od zer drug sbrags ldan pa'i srung 'khor ni// utpal gsar pas bar mtshams kun khyab pa// sra brtan rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgoms pa yis// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar shog /ces pa 'di yang bande blo gsal gyis sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ //gong gi brgyud pa'i kha skong la/ rjes gnang rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ /mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun phrin las par// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos (410)grub stsol/ /zhes pa'i mtshams/ tshar chen rje dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub la// gsol ba=

/mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar pa// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// rigs kun khyab bdag kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba 'debs so= /zhes dang*/ khrid kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ bsod nams mchog grub rjes su/ rin chen 'jam dpal blo gsal bstan 'dzin dang*// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// 'chi med dpal ster kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba= /zhes sam/ yang na/ kun dga' blo gros chos nyid ye shes dang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so= /'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dang*// blo gsal bstan skyong rnam 'dren ngag gi dbang*// snyan brgyud dpal ster rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// rgyal ba'i yum mchog /sogs dang sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas sbyar ba dge/// /
